label: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.9 a.1 for POTENCY_1 in the subject: whatever changes in a respect…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.9 a.1 ('omne quod quocumque modo mutatur, est aliquo modo in potentia') for potency in the subject: whatever changes in a respect between two times is in potency in that respect. The potency-in-another reading of q.9 a.2 would not give it.
